about.title: What is Global Skin Metrics?
about.p1: We are an independent price comparator for CS2 skins, knives, gloves and items. We gather public offers from several marketplaces and sort them so you can quickly see where to buy cheaper. We do not sell items or process payments — we inform you and redirect you to the marketplace where the purchase is completed.
about.stepsTitle: How it works in four steps
about.guidesIntro: Besides the comparator, we publish original content to help you buy wisely and understand the CS2 market.
about.trust: Questions or want to collaborate? Visit <aboutLink>About us</aboutLink> or write us at <contactLink>Contact</contactLink>. See also our <legalLink>Legal notice</legalLink> and <privacyLink>Privacy policy</privacyLink>.

1.title: Browse the catalog
1.text: Search by name, category, wear or rarity among thousands of CS2 skins, knives, gloves and items.

2.title: We compare marketplaces
2.text: We check public prices on Steam, Skinport, DMarket, Waxpeer, CSFloat and other sources when available.

3.title: Pick the best offer
3.text: Offers are sorted lowest to highest in USD so you see where it is cheapest right now.

4.title: Buy on the marketplace
4.text: We redirect you to the external site where the transaction happens. Global Skin Metrics does not sell items.

guideLinks.buySafe: How to buy CS2 skins safely

q1.a: Global Skin Metrics is an independent CS2 skin price comparator. We gather offers from several marketplaces to help you decide where to buy cheaper.

q2.q: Does Global Skin Metrics sell skins?
q2.a: No. We are not a store or intermediary. Purchases happen on external marketplaces like Steam or Skinport.

q3.q: Are prices exact in real time?
q3.a: Prices come from public sources and can change within minutes. Always verify the final amount on the marketplace before paying.

q4.q: Are you affiliated with Valve or Counter-Strike?
q4.a: No. We are not affiliated with Valve Corporation or Counter-Strike.

q5.q: Do I need an account to use the comparator?
q5.a: No. You can check prices without signing up. An account is optional for alerts or premium tools.

q6.q: Where do item images and data come from?
q6.a: We use public CSGO-API (ByMykel) and linked marketplace previews. Price data comes from the linked markets when available.
